subject: Onboarding: Private deployment security & network isolation (MedTec Solutions)
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medtec.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: MedTec Security Team <security@medtec.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: private deployment requirements and compliance docs

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team found the latency/cost controls very interesting. As discussed on the call, we need to start a security intake for any private/on-prem deployment evaluation. High level asks from our side to kick this off: 

- Current SOC 2 status (Type I/Type II and expected date for next audit)
- GDPR processing obligations and sample DPA wording you support
- HIPAA posture (BAA availability) — we are a HIPAA customer for parts of this project
- A vendor security questionnaire that we can complete (we have an internal RFP intake)
- Any baseline network diagrams you can share for on-prem / VPC options (we need to map to our perimeter controls)

Can you point me to the person who will own the architectural answers and who will own the compliance artifacts? We’d like the initial intake completed this week if possible so our procurement team can proceed.

Also, we will likely evaluate an air-gapped (read-only / isolated) configuration for our most sensitive workloads — please include that as an option in the intake.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Director, IT Risk & Security
MedTec Solutions
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medtec.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, MedTec Security Team <security@medtec.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: private deployment requirements and compliance docs

Tom — great to connect. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Recap (from call)
- MedTec evaluating Redwood Private (VPC and on-prem) for PHI workloads; interest in air-gapped option for isolated environments.
- Procurement wants SOC 2 evidence + vendor questionnaire; architecture team needs diagrams and network boundary details.

Action items (owner / target)
1) Redwood to send initial RFI spreadsheet + baseline network diagram (attachment: redwood_rfi_initial.xlsx, proposed_network_diagram_v0.pdf) — owner: me — ETA: EOD Mon (11/23)
2) Redwood to surface SOC 2 status and DPA template — owner: Neha Kapoor (Security & Compliance) — ETA: 3 business days
3) Architecture deep-dive (30–45m) to map firewall/NAT, peering, and air-gap footprint — owner: Aditya Rao (Infra Solutions) — propose slots below
4) MedTec to return completed vendor questionnaire and confirm primary security contact (please send Sec lead and firewall/network engineer) — owner: MedTec — ETA: 5 business days

Air-gap note: We can support an air-gapped model for inference if you require no external egress from the inference cluster. There are multiple flavors (fully air-gapped with manual model sync, and semi-isolated with tightly controlled egress via a sanctioned jump box). We will outline tradeoffs in the deep-dive.

Proposed deep-dive slots (PST):
- Tue 11/24 10:00–10:45
- Wed 11/25 09:00–09:45
- Thu 11/26 13:00–13:45

Please confirm a slot and security contact(s). I attached the initial RFI and a basic network diagram to illustrate typical on-prem and VPC topologies.

Regards,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_rfi_initial.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposed_network_diagram_v0.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medtec.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: private deployment requirements and compliance docs

Tom / Jasmine — I can run the architecture deep-dive. A couple quick clarifications that will make the session productive: 

1) For the air-gapped option, which model update flow do you prefer? (a) periodic physical media transfer or (b) pull-only from a restricted Bastion with audited egress. Each has different operational overhead.
2) Do you need the inference cluster to live on-prem (customer datacenter) or in a MedTec-managed VPC in a cloud region with dedicated tenancy? We’ll prepare notes for both.
3) Firewall specifics: will you own the perimeter NAT and outbound IPs, or do you expect Redwood to provide a fixed egress IP (we can accommodate both with reserved interfaces)?

Available to meet: Tue 11/24 10:00–10:45 (preferred) or Wed 11/25 09:00.

I attached our on-prem checklist that covers kernel/hypervisor/minimum GPU driver versions and expected port lists — helps speed the compatibility assessment.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Lead Infrastructure Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment: onprem-security-checklist.pdf
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medtec.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@medtec.com>, MedTec Security Team <security@medtec.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: private deployment requirements and compliance docs

Thanks Jasmine / Aditya —

We’ll take Tue 11/24 10:00–10:45 PST. Alice Park (copied) will be our security lead and will coordinate the questionnaire. I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire for your intake team to populate (MedTec_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx).

Quick answers:
- We prefer the Bastion/pull-only model if it simplifies ops, but please outline the tradeoffs in the deep-dive.
- Primary goal is cloud-hosted VPC in our dedicated tenancy; on-prem is a fallback for a smaller pilot.
- MedTec will provide perimeter NAT / egress controls; we’ll need Redwood to document required egress IPs and ports.

Request: Can Redwood provide a short SOC 2 status summary and DPA draft by EOD Fri (11/27)? Procurement needs that to move forward.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — see you on Tuesday.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Director, IT Risk & Security
MedTec Solutions

Attachment: MedTec_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx (uploaded by MedTec)
